targets.rawSql:
SELECT t.actor AS agent, t.runs, t.tokens, t.cost_usd, ifNull(c.tool_calls, 0) AS tool_calls
FROM
(
    SELECT actor, uniqExact(agent_id) AS runs, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 3) AS cost_usd
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != ''
    GROUP BY actor
) AS t
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT actor, count() AS tool_calls FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND agent_id != '' GROUP BY actor
) AS c USING (actor)
ORDER BY tokens DESC

SELECT s.skill AS skill, s.launches, ifNull(t.tokens, 0) AS tokens, ifNull(t.cost_usd, 0) AS cost_usd,
       ifNull(c.tool_calls, 0) AS tool_calls, s.triggers
FROM
(
    SELECT skill_name AS skill, count() AS launches,
           arrayStringConcat(groupUniqArray(skill_trigger), ', ') AS triggers
    FROM cc.events WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'skill_activated'
    GROUP BY skill
) AS s
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT skill, sum(total_tokens) AS tokens, round(sum(cost_usd), 3) AS cost_usd
    FROM cc.api_requests WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != '' GROUP BY skill
) AS t ON s.skill = t.skill
LEFT JOIN
(
    SELECT skill, count() AS tool_calls
    FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND skill != '' GROUP BY skill
) AS c ON s.skill = c.skill
ORDER BY launches DESC

panels.title: Main vs subagents by tool
panels.description: Top 15 tools by calls: calls made by the main session vs by subagents (agent_id set).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT tool_name AS tool, countIf(agent_id = '') AS main, countIf(agent_id != '') AS subagent
FROM cc.tool_calls WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR actor = '${actor}') AND ('${skill}' = '__all' OR skill = '${skill}') AND $__timeFilter(ts)
GROUP BY tool_name
ORDER BY count() DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Subagent outliers (max vs mean tokens)
panels.description: Completed subagent runs per agent type: tokens of one run (total_tokens of subagent_completed). x mean = max / mean; 6 and above is highlighted (the cc.tips agent-outlier rule also needs max above 50k). Ignores the skill variable; the actor variable matches the agent type.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT agent_type, count() AS runs, round(avg(agent_total_tokens)) AS mean_tokens, max(agent_total_tokens) AS max_tokens, round(max(agent_total_tokens) / avg(agent_total_tokens), 1) AS x_mean, sum(agent_total_tokens) AS total_tokens
FROM cc.events WHERE ('__all' IN (${account:singlequote}) OR account_uuid IN (${account:singlequote})) AND ('${project}' = '__all' OR project = '${project}') AND ('${session}' = '__all' OR session_id = '${session}') AND ('${actor}' = '__all' OR agent_type = '${actor}') AND $__timeFilter(ts) AND event = 'subagent_completed' AND agent_type != ''
GROUP BY agent_type
ORDER BY max_tokens DESC
